entries.title: Genesis 36:1
segments: Now these are the generations of Esau (the same is Edom).

entries.title: Genesis 36:2
segments: Esau took his wives of the daughters of Canaan: Adah the daughter of Elon the Hittite, and Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon the Hivite,

entries.title: Genesis 36:3
segments: and Basemath Ishmael's daughter, sister of Nebaioth.

entries.title: Genesis 36:4
segments: And Adah bare to Esau Eliphaz; and Basemath bare Reuel;

entries.title: Genesis 36:5
segments: and Oholibamah bare Jeush, and Jalam, and Korah: these are the sons of Esau, that were born unto him in the land of Canaan.

entries.title: Genesis 36:6
segments: And Esau took his wives, and his sons, and his daughters, and all the souls of his house, and his cattle, and all his beasts, and all his possessions, which he had gather in the land of Canaan; and went into a land away from his brother Jacob.

entries.title: Genesis 36:7
segments: For their substance was too great for them to dwell together; and the land of their sojournings could not bear them because of their cattle.

entries.title: Genesis 36:8
segments: And Esau dwelt in mount Seir: Esau is Edom.

entries.title: Genesis 36:9
segments: And these are the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in mount Seir:

entries.title: Genesis 36:10
segments: these are the names of Esau's sons: Eliphaz the son of Adah the wife of Esau, Reuel the son of Basemath the wife of Esau.

entries.title: Genesis 36:11
segments: And the sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam, and Kenaz.

entries.title: Genesis 36:12
segments: And Timna was concubine to Eliphaz Esau's son; and she bare to Eliphaz Amalek: these are the sons of Adah, Esau's wife.

entries.title: Genesis 36:13
segments: And these are the sons of Reuel: Nahath, and Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah: these were the sons of Basemath, Esau's wife.

entries.title: Genesis 36:14
segments: And these were the sons of Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon, Esau's wife: and she bare to Esau Jeush, and Jalam, and Korah.

entries.title: Genesis 36:15
segments: These are the chiefs of the sons of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz the first-born of Esau: chief Teman, chief Omar, chief Zepho, chief Kenaz,

entries.title: Genesis 36:16
segments: chief Korah, chief Gatam, chief Amalek: these are the chiefs that came of Eliphaz in the land of Edom; these are the sons of Adah.

entries.title: Genesis 36:17
segments: And these are the sons of Reuel, Esau's son: chief Nahath, chief Zerah, chief Shammah, chief Mizzah: these are the chiefs that came of Reuel in the land of Edom; these are the sons of Basemath, Esau's wife.

entries.title: Genesis 36:18
segments: And these are the sons of Oholibamah, Esau's wife: chief Jeush, chief Jalam, chief Korah: these are the chiefs that came of Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, Esau's wife.

entries.title: Genesis 36:19
segments: These are the sons of Esau, and these are their chiefs: the same is Edom.

entries.title: Genesis 36:20
segments: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, the inhabitants of the land: Lotan and Shobal and Zibeon and Anah,

entries.title: Genesis 36:21
segments: and Dishon and Ezer and Dishan: these are the chiefs that came of the Horites, the children of Seir in the land of Edom.

entries.title: Genesis 36:22
segments: And the children of Lotan were Hori and Heman. And Lotan's sister was Timna.

entries.title: Genesis 36:23
segments: And these are the children of Shobal: Alvan and Manahath and Ebal, Shepho and Onam.

entries.title: Genesis 36:24
segments: And these are the children of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah; this is Anah who found the hot springs in the wilderness, as he fed the asses of Zibeon his father.

entries.title: Genesis 36:25
segments: And these are the children of Anah: Dishon and Oholibamah the daughter of Anah.

entries.title: Genesis 36:26
segments: And these are the children of Dishon: Hemdan and Eshban and Ithran and Cheran.

entries.title: Genesis 36:27
segments: These are the children of Ezer: Bilhan and Zaavan and Akan.

entries.title: Genesis 36:28
segments: These are the children of Dishan: Uz and Aran.

entries.title: Genesis 36:29
segments: These are the chiefs that came of the Horites: chief Lotan, chief Shobal, chief Zibeon, chief Anah,

entries.title: Genesis 36:30
segments: chief Dishon, chief Ezer, chief Dishan: these are the chiefs that came of the Horites, according to their chiefs in the land of Seir.

entries.title: Genesis 36:31
segments: And these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom, before there reigned any king over the children of Israel.

entries.title: Genesis 36:32
segments: And Bela the son of Beor reigned in Edom; and the name of his city was Dinhabah.

entries.title: Genesis 36:33
segments: And Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.

entries.title: Genesis 36:34
segments: And Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his stead.

entries.title: Genesis 36:35
segments: And Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Avith.

entries.title: Genesis 36:36
segments: And Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.

entries.title: Genesis 36:37
segments: And Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth by the River reigned in his stead.

entries.title: Genesis 36:38
segments: And Shaul died, and Baal-hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.

entries.title: Genesis 36:39
segments: And Baal-hanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Pau; and his wife's name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Me-zahab.

entries.title: Genesis 36:40
segments: And these are the names of the chiefs that came of Esau, according to their families, after their places, by their names: chief Timna, chief Alvah, chief Jetheth,

entries.title: Genesis 36:41
segments: chief Oholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,

entries.title: Genesis 36:42
segments: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,

entries.title: Genesis 36:43
segments: chief Magdiel, chief Iram: these are the chiefs of Edom, according to their habitations in the land of their possession. This is Esau, the father of the Edomites.
